source_note: 自然数的r次幂的部分和估计
english_source_note: Partial Sum Estimates for Powers of Integers
callout_id: 自然数的r次幂的部分和估计#6
english_title: First Terms of the Asymptotic Expansion for 0 < r < 1
statement_en:
If $0<r<1$, then
$$\sum_{k=1}^n k^{-r}=\frac{1}{1-r} n^{1-r}+\zeta(r)+\frac{1}{2} n^{-r}-\frac{r}{12} n^{-r-1}+E_r(n),$$
where the remainder satisfies
$$|E_r(n)|<\frac{r(r+1)(r+2)}{720n^{r+3}}.$$
key_techniques: analytic continuation viewpoint for zeta values
